name: burst-code-edit-lm-studio-vs-llama-server-inkling-2-mini
problems: after the run: the benchmark scripts have uncommitted changes, so the code that ran is not recorded
notes: M1 Max 64 GB, burst. Inkling 2 Mini (inkling2_loop) does not load on Nekko's pinned llama.cpp b12565, so every llama.cpp arm here runs the official b12818 release (commit a38695013, archive sha256 b05fc72e...) and both Nekko arms are llama-server started with Nekko's exact argv, not through Nekko's router. This is what Nekko would deliver after its engine pin moves to b12818 or later; it is not what the shipped app does today. Drafter: maternion/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2-GGUF Q8_0 (community conversion). --no-think sets reasoning_effort none; Inkling still thinks briefly at effort 0. Pairwise against llama-server-plain (-m --port -c 8192; its default context would take the whole 64 GB) because two 27B servers fill the GPU working set. nekko-dflash2: Nekko router on 11500, preset draftModelId=draft/maternion_Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2-GGUF/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2-Draft-Q8_0; Nekko argv --ctx-size 65536 --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --cache-reuse 256 --no-cache-idle-slots --spec-default --spec-draft-model <drafter> --spec-draft-ngl all --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 7. nekko-classic: llama-server started with Nekko's exact default argv (n-gram --spec-default, no drafter), outside the router because Nekko's memory budget keeps one 27B model resident. lm-studio: LM Studio, llama.cpp runtime 2.81.0, lms load defaults (8192 context, parallel 4, its repeat penalty), same file by hard link. Code edits are judged on the reply's last python block (Qwen3.8 reasons inline despite /no_think).
